# aptabase_apps (Data Source)

Lists every aptabase-plus app owned by or shared with the authenticated user - useful for discovering apps to `import` into Terraform management.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aptabase_apps" "all" {}

output "app_ids" {
  value = [for app in data.aptabase_apps.all.apps : app.id]
}
```
